name: ChatGPT Pro 100

check.label: Codex usage page, or /status in the CLI

reset.rule: A 7-day window. The usage API and Settings → Usage show the exact reset time.
stipulations: Codex, ChatGPT Work, and ChatGPT for Word, Excel and PowerPoint share this allowance.
Local messages and cloud tasks share it. A cloud task may use more than a local message.
GitHub code reviews (@codex on a PR, or automatic reviews) are metered as Code Review usage. Local /review runs count here like any other task.
Fast mode spends it at 2x on GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, and at 2.5x on other models.
GPT-6 Pro in Chat has its own weekly message limit, separate from this allowance.
After a reset, the next week starts at your first Codex or Work request, so the reset day can move.

resets.label: Banked Codex resets

count.rule: Given out in OpenAI promotions, including some referral offers. The usage API reports how many you hold and how many you can use right now.

resets.howTo: Desktop app: Settings → Usage & billing, select the reset and confirm. CLI: /usage, then Redeem reset.
stipulations: Free. Each reset has its own expiry date, shown in your account or the offer.
It restores the weekly allowance to 100%. It doesn't raise the limit.
You can only use one when the weekly allowance has less than 80% left.
The desktop app can use one for you when 10% or less is left, if you turn on "Allow your assistant to use resets". It asks each time.
Unused or expired resets aren't refunded or replaced.

resets.label: Paid instant reset

count.rule: Bought one at a time. OpenAI doesn't state a cap. The price is shown at checkout.

resets.howTo: Desktop app: Settings → Usage, Buy an instant reset. Or the reset offer banner when you hit your weekly limit.
stipulations: Personal Plus and Pro accounts only, on ChatGPT web and the Codex desktop app. Availability varies by account and country.
Applies the moment you pay, even if usage is left. It can't be saved for later.
It pulls your normal weekly allowance forward. It doesn't add extra usage.
Your next weekly reset is 7 days after your first request following the reset, not 7 days after payment.

overage: After the weekly allowance, buy credits under Settings → Usage, or turn on auto top-up. Included usage is spent first, then credits. Credits expire 12 months after purchase.

how: Codex on Pro has no 5-hour limit, only a weekly allowance.
Pro 100 recently got double its previous Codex and Work allowance.
GPT-6 Pro chat has its own weekly limit, separate from the Codex and Work allowance.
ext: The Codex extension works in most VS Code forks, including Cursor.
quirks: Ultrafast isn't available on Pro 100, even with credits.
Signing into Codex with an API key bills API rates instead of your plan.
Billed monthly only; there's no annual option.
The Codex usage API calls this plan "prolite".

events.what: Starting in December, ChatGPT and Codex share one token-based allowance on Plus, Pro and Business. Instant chat won't count. OpenAI gives no exact date and some accounts may switch earlier.
